# Manna Market

> Online shop in Bendigo, Victoria, Australia selling tools for home sourdough bakers: rattan bannetons with linen liners, flax linen couches, bread lames with spare blades, bench and bowl dough scrapers and linen bread bags. Posted within Australia only. Contact: bake@manna-market.com

## Pages
- [Home](https://manna-market.com/): price list, tool lines, FAQ
- [Bannetons](https://manna-market.com/bannetons.html): sizes by dough weight, liners, care, starter kit
- [Lames and scrapers](https://manna-market.com/lames-and-scrapers.html): scoring, blades, scraper pair
- [Linen and bread bags](https://manna-market.com/linen-and-bread-bags.html): couche and bread bag, weave and washing
- [Order baking tools](https://manna-market.com/order-baking-tools.html): order request form with running total
- [About](https://manna-market.com/about-manna-market.html)
- [Postage and delivery](https://manna-market.com/postage-and-delivery.html)
- [Returns and exchanges](https://manna-market.com/returns-and-exchanges.html)

- Round banneton, 22 cm, with liner: A$34
- Oval banneton, 28 cm, with liner: A$38
- Linen couche, 60 × 90 cm: A$29
- Bread lame + 5 blades: A$24
- Scraper pair, bench + bowl: A$18
- Linen bread bag: A$22
- Starter kit (banneton, lame, scraper): A$69
